Text:
School is back in session across Shelby County. That means buses, drop-off lines, crosswalks, and kids heading to class are back on our roads.

A few extra seconds behind the wheel can make a real difference: slow down when school-zone lights are flashing, put the phone away, yield at crosswalks, and watch carefully near bus stops and parked cars.

When a school bus has red lights flashing or its stop arm out, stop and wait. In Texas, drivers must stop unless the bus is on the opposite side of a divided highway.

Tickets are expensive, but the bigger point is simple: help every child get to school and back home safely.
